name: Tear Down Expired AWS VPN
description: Ends an AWS VPN deployment whose time is up (R2b): run every hour by a schedule, it reads the end time from the Terraform state and - only when it has passed - removes the router's AWS block under a revert timer, proves it gone and destroys the AWS side with exactly the planned destroy. The approval was the Deploy card's end time; a teardown that fails opens a Work Center task (ADR 0068, PID S13 R2b)
